DeterminationBasis: T16-001 requires the governed claim to name or unambiguously preserve its evidence basis and includes both evidence and provenance in the required evidence set. This directly establishes inspectable traceability from the claim to the evidence supporting it without requiring a separate generic traceability test.

T16-010 requires the claim class or claimed property to remain unambiguous and prevents silent movement between materially different claim meanings. T16-001 independently prevents the material claim from outrunning the evidence supporting it. Together they prevent a claim from silently combining multiple claim classes where the evidence establishes only one class: class meaning must remain explicit and the claim cannot extend beyond its established evidence basis.
